title: The Lugon Framework: Informational Foundations of Physical Law; Part V — The Unified Equilibrium: Binding the Invariants
content: Part V of The Lugon Framework: Informational Foundations of Physical Law unifies the preceding works into a single equilibrium law that binds spacetime curvature, quantum coherence, and thermodynamic evolution under one conserved quantity—total informational capacity. The earlier parts established the scaffolding: information can exist without energy (Part I), the Lugon Kernel couples the fundamental invariants of physics (Part II), entropy and dark energy represent the dynamic bookkeeping of that coupling (Part III), and gravity acts as the curvature-feedback channel maintaining the ledger (Part IV). Here those ideas converge into a single governing field equation, the Unified Equilibrium Law: in which is the Einstein tensor of spacetime, the conventional stress–energy tensor, and the informational exchange tensor whose coupling enforces exact capacity balance between the physical domain (ℝ) and the informational domain (ℚ). The equation unites geometry, energy, and information as co-evolving aspects of one invariant system: curvature adjusts whenever informational density changes, and informational flux responds whenever curvature departs from equilibrium. From the balanced action I derive the associated Noether ledger current that guarantees conservation of total informational capacity even when local stress–energy appears non-conserved. Linearization of the law yields a Lyapunov-stable relaxation equation demonstrating that all bounded perturbations decay causally toward equilibrium. In limiting regimes, the same equation reproduces General Relativity, Quantum Field Theory, and Thermodynamics, showing that the familiar conservation laws of physics are localized projections of this deeper invariance. The framework predicts three falsifiable observables: (i) a finite gravitational-wave memory floor, (ii) cosmological constancy of the residual curvature Λ as an informational remainder, and (iii) coherence plateaus in precision-clock networks set by the minimum ledger flux. Together they define an experimental envelope for testing the theory. The coercive structure of the equilibrium constraint also explains temporal asymmetry: entropy increases because informational corrections can relax but not reverse without violating boundedness, embedding the arrow of time within an otherwise symmetric conservation law. The Unified Equilibrium completes the Lugon program by showing that the universe is not sustained by external forces or hidden variables but by continuous self-correction. Reality functions as a closed informational ledger—its geometry, energy, and entropy merely the accounting languages of a single, perpetual equilibrium.
